name: Soldiers of Camaraderie
body:
Price 6,000 gp; Aura moderate divination and conjuration; CL 10; Weight 0.5 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This small ivory statuette resembles a pair of soldiers in formation. The soldiers can be separated and restored to a single statuette as a move action. As long as the soldiers are carried by two creatures they may communicate as though by telepathy regardless of distance as long as they remain on the same plane. In addition a single soldier can be thrown to the ground and shattered as a standard action, teleporting you adjacent to (or nearest safe space) the creature which carries the other statuette. A creature can only benefit from one statuette at a time. Once one soldier has broken, the other becomes magically inert, though is still a fine art piece worth approximately 200 gp.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 3,000 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells telepathic bond, teleport
